summary: Completed comprehensive testing of RACCOON APP legal/compliance pages, age verification modal, signup terms checkbox, and premium filter gating. All 12 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend UI features verified successfully.

test_credentials.guest_user: No credentials needed - click Start Matching on /guest page

context_for_next_testing_agent: Legal/compliance pages fully functional. Age verification modal appears on first visit and stores confirmation in localStorage. Signup page requires terms checkbox before submission. Premium filter gating works on Guest page with lock icons and premium modal.

age_verification_modal.details: Modal appears on first visit, shows 18+ requirement, has 'I am 18 or older - Enter' and 'I am under 18 - Leave' buttons, stores confirmation in localStorage as 'raccoon_age_verified', links to Terms and Privacy pages

landing_page_footer.details: Footer contains Terms, Privacy, Guidelines links and '18+ only' text

terms_of_service_page.details: /terms route loads with professional legal content including: Acceptance of Terms, Age Requirement (18+), User Responsibilities, Prohibited Content & Behavior, Account Suspension, Premium Services, Limitation of Liability, Privacy, Changes to Terms, Contact info

privacy_policy_page.details: /privacy route loads with data collection info including: Information We Collect (Account, Automatic, Communication), How We Use Information, Data Storage & Security, Cookies & Tracking, Third-Party Services, Data Sharing, Your Rights, Data Retention, Children's Privacy, Contact info

community_guidelines_page.details: /guidelines route loads with DO/DON'T sections: DO - Be Respectful, Have Real Conversations, Report Bad Behavior, Use Skip Respectfully; DON'T - No Nudity, No Harassment, No Hate Speech, No Spam, No Minors, No Recording; Consequences section with Warning, Temporary Ban, Permanent Ban

refund_policy_page.details: /refund route loads with subscription info: Weekly ($2.99), Monthly ($7.99), 3 Months ($19.99), Billing & Renewal info, Refund Eligibility criteria, How to Request Refund (billing@raccoonapp.com), Processing Time, Payment Security

signup_terms_checkbox.details: Signup page has checkbox with text 'I am 18+ and agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy', links to /terms and /privacy, form shows error toast when submitted without checking, checkbox visual indicator works

guest_page_premium_gating.details: Guest page shows lock icons on 'Male' and 'Female' options in 'Match me with' section and on 'Country' filter. Clicking locked filters shows 'Unlock Premium' modal with 'View Plans' and 'Maybe Later' buttons. 'View Plans' navigates to /premium page

premium_page_subscription_plans.details: Premium page shows 3 plans: Weekly ($2.99/week), Monthly ($7.99/month with 'BEST VALUE' tag), 3 Months ($19.99/3 months with 'SAVE 44%' tag). Features list includes: Choose gender preference, Choose country preference, Priority matching queue, All camera filters, Unlimited skips, Ad-free experience. Trust badges: Secure payment, Cancel anytime
